Session/Topic: The Endgame: Preparing for an Exit Before You Need One
The best exits are built long before they're taken.
Description: Most founders never think about the exit — until they're forced to. But the most valuable businesses are built with the end in mind from the very beginning. This panel brings together voices from private equity, seasoned operators who have executed business sales and acquisitions, and an M&A attorney to reveal what it truly takes to prepare for an exit — and why it matters even if you never intend to sell. You'll learn how thinking like an eventual seller makes you a sharper founder today: building cleaner operations, stronger value, and more optionality for whatever future you choose. Come with your questions — this is a rare chance to see your business through the eyes of those who buy, sell, and value them.
